title: ALMA Lensing Cluster Survey: Properties of Millimeter Galaxies Hosting X-Ray-detected Active Galactic Nuclei
question: What are the multi-wavelength physical properties (X-ray luminosities, mass-accretion rates, star-formation rates, stellar masses) and evolutionary stages of millimeter galaxies hosting X-ray detected AGNs in the ALMA Lensing Cluster Survey?

what.value: 180 secure ALCS 1.2 mm continuum source catalog and lensing magnification factors

evidence.quote: We cross-matched the *Chandra* detected sources with the secure ALCS source list comprising of 180 millimeter detected galaxies (see Fujimoto et al., in prep.).

evidence.quote: The stellar masses and SFRs of ALESS-XAGNs, UDF-XAGNs, ASAGAO-XAGNs, and AS2UDS-XAGN are estimated by the `MAGPHYS` code (cite: 2015ApJ...806..110D; 2020PASJ...72...69Y; 2020MNRAS.494.3828D), while those of SXDF-XAGNs are estimated by the `X-CIGALE` code (cite: 2021ApJ...909..188S).

The X-ray luminosities of ALESS-XAGNs, UDF-XAGNs and ASAGAO-XAGNs, and AS2UDS-XAGNs are taken from (cite: 2013ApJ...778..179W), (cite: 2018ApJ...853...24U), and (cite: 2018ApJS..236...48K), respectively.
We also extract the X-ray luminosities of SXDF-XAGNs from (cite: 2012ApJ...761..143N)

recipe.goal: ALMA data reduction, imaging, and continuum source extraction
recipe.method: Calibrate and image ALMA Band 6 data with CASA pipeline using natural weighting (native ~1'' and uv-tapered ~2'' beams), then extract 1.2 mm continuum sources using SExtractor to build the 180-source ALCS catalog.
key_parameters: natural weighting, native beam ~1'', uv-tapered beam ~2'', rms ~60 uJy beam^-1

recipe.goal: Chandra X-ray data reduction, source detection, cross-matching, and spectrum extraction
recipe.method: Process archival Chandra ACIS data up to 2017 with CIAO, combine with merge_obs, detect sources in 0.5–7.0 keV with wavdetect, cross-match with the 180 secure ALCS sources within Chandra positional uncertainty, and extract spectra in circular apertures.
key_parameters: 0.5–7.0 keV band; wavdetect false-positive probability threshold = 10^-8; wavelet scales = sqrt(2) sequence (1 to 16 pixels)
Cross-match radius = root sum square of 3 sigma statistical error and 99% Chandra absolute astrometry uncertainty (1.4'')
Spectral extraction aperture radius = 1.5'' (A370-ID110) and 2.0'' (M0416-ID117, M0329-ID11)
assumptions: ALMA positional uncertainty is negligible compared to Chandra

recipe.method: Fit observed (uncorrected for magnification) X-ray spectra with an absorbed power-law model (phabs*zphabs*zpowerlaw) in XSPEC, then correct intrinsic 0.5–8.0 keV luminosity for lensing magnification.
key_parameters: Fixed redshifts (z = 1.06, 2.09, 2.84) and fixed Galactic N_H from Willingale et al. (2013)
assumptions: Flat universe with H_0 = 70.4 km s^-1 Mpc^-1 and Omega_M = 0.272; lensing magnification factors mu = 1.19, 1.57, 2.46

recipe.goal: Multi-component X-ray to millimeter SED modeling
recipe.method: Perform Bayesian multi-component SED modeling of magnification-corrected X-ray to millimeter photometry using CIGALE v2022.0.
key_parameters: Delayed SFH, Bruzual & Charlot (2003) SSP, modified Calzetti attenuation, Inoue (2011) nebular emission, SKIRTOR AGN torus model, Jones et al. (2017) THEMIS dust emission, X-ray photon index fixed to 1.9; parameter grid in Table 2
assumptions: Chabrier (2003) IMF, metallicity = 0.02, energy balance between UV/optical and IR, isotropic AGN X-ray radiation

recipe.goal: Comparison with star-forming main sequence and SMBH-galaxy co-evolution relations
recipe.method: Compare derived M_*, SFR, and L_X with other ALMA+Chandra and X-ray AGN samples in the M_*-SFR and L_X-SFR planes, converting L_X to SMBH mass-accretion rate.
key_parameters: Return fraction R = 0.41, mass ratio A = 200 (bulge) and 400 (stellar), bolometric correction kappa_0.5-8 = 13, radiation efficiency eta = 0.05
assumptions: Negligible systematic offset between CIGALE and MAGPHYS for high-sSFR galaxies (log sSFR > -9.6)

answer_key.quantity: Number of X-ray detected AGNs among ALCS millimeter sources

evidence.quote: Utilizing the archival data of *Chandra*, we identify three AGNs at $z=$1.06, 2.09, and 2.84 among the 180 millimeter sources securely detected in the ALCS (of which 155 are inside the coverage of *Chandra*).
